script:
Zhao Tianhu (赵天虎)
You are Zhao Tianhu, an outstanding police officer in City A who has solved countless major cases and is deeply loved by the people, known as the nemesis of evil. However, even such an excellent police officer has shadows that linger in his heart.
This matter began on December 22nd. You happened to be driving past a building when you saw a car. You didn't think it was strange at first - there are plenty of cars on the road - but after following the same route for some time, you discovered that a taxi was following that car. You felt tonight's events were not simple, so you followed along.
At 20:00, you followed to the destination. You parked your car at a distance and used binoculars to observe the situation. You waited until 20:31 when a figure ran down from upstairs, bumped into someone, and left.
20:33, two people came down from upstairs, one chasing the other while running. The pursuer seemed to have a machete in hand. You felt you should intervene, so you calculated their movement route.
20:36, you successfully blocked one person's path, but the other person disappeared. This person had a knife in hand, so you took him back to the police station for questioning the next day.
December 23rd, someone reported discovering a female corpse. Arriving at the scene downstairs, there were traces of blood, and the car you had been following was also there, with a small pool of blood in a nearby corner. Entering the house, there were also blood traces in the hallway, extending to both the bathroom and a bedroom. In the bedroom, you discovered a female corpse named Qian Qian.
There was also a pool of blood on the floor of the room, along with a severed arm that appeared to be a right arm. The corpse had a scarf wrapped around her neck, and the strangulation marks seemed consistent with the scarf, clearly showing great force had been used. There were impact marks on the head with slight bleeding. There were also blood traces flowing from her lower body, cause unknown. In her brother Qian Da's room, there were many torn photos of Qian Qian, meaning unclear. No other physical evidence was found for now, only waiting for further search results.
You investigated among her neighbors nearby, but the neighbors only said they heard very noisy sounds and didn't pay attention. However, you noticed one person - her neighbor Huang Dong was obviously shaken during questioning, his eyes wandering, also claiming he went to sleep early and knew nothing. You made special note of this person's appearance.
Through detailed investigation, you discovered that the blood traces, the car, and the right arm belonged to her supervisor Li Dongqiang, and the person arrested last night was indeed Qian Da, who had a bloody machete that matched Li Dongqiang's blood. During interrogation, Li Dongqiang's right arm was indeed missing. He cooperated fully with police investigation, admitting to being at the crime scene, and according to police intelligence, the time of death was between 20:30 and 20:40. Li Dongqiang's severed arm indeed occurred before the victim's death. The victim's cause of death was strangulation, and there was a fetus in her belly, though already dead. The causes of other injuries were unclear.
With only one hand, he couldn't have committed the crime, so the matter had to be dropped. However, when leaving, he said he had important clues but couldn't reveal them yet. You noticed his remaining left arm had a bloody watch, though blood was reasonable under the circumstances.
Qian Da was much less cooperative, remaining silent throughout. Even when questioned about the machete, he said nothing, which was very troublesome. The machete only had his right hand fingerprints, so he definitely couldn't escape involvement. Even so, with nothing to be gained, the matter had to be dropped.
The fetus in the victim's belly belonged to her and her company colleague Liu Jin. Liu Jin had just been fired, and when police went to summon him, they found he wasn't home and appeared to have fled based on the circumstances. When searching Liu Jin's home, you found a scarf matching the murder weapon. Therefore, reasoning that if Qian Da wanted to kill, he would more likely use the machete, you identified the fugitive Liu Jin as the murderer and planned to close the case hastily.
December 25th, to close the case quickly, the higher-ups set today as the final deadline. You continued searching for evidence at the crime scene - Qian Qian's home - but still found nothing. Just then, you saw Huang Dong acting suspiciously at the door, not knowing what he was doing. You planned to approach and question him, but found the person had disappeared. The search finally ended with no more valuable information, so the superiors had to identify the fugitive Liu Jin as the murderer and issued a warrant.
December 26th, just as Qian Da was about to be charged with intentional assault, he was bailed out by an unknown person. The police station received an anonymous report that Li Dongqiang had been kidnapped, providing the location where he was spotted. From the scene surveillance, there were two kidnappers - one identifiable as a thug named Ren Long, the other difficult to identify, though you felt you'd seen this person before. After Ren Long was arrested, he confessed to the kidnapping and claimed he had been hired to throw the victim into the sea.
When asked who hired him, he suddenly foamed at the mouth and died from poison hidden in his mouth. Everything seemed clear yet sank into the depths again.
Ten years later, December 22, 2016, as you reflected on this period, you suddenly felt confused, and when you woke up, you found yourself tied to a chair. Four others were in the same situation, three of whom you'd seen before but couldn't remember clearly. Then you all looked toward the person standing at the table.
acts_goal: You actually wanted to hastily close the case back then, so when asked about evidence-related questions, try not to be too clear, but stick to your judgment from that year (if you discover facts that overturn your reasoning, please trust your current judgment).
